entry.author: Callaghan Innovation
entry.summary:
What's the toughest part of product development? 🤔✏️

We recently sat down with our Innovation and Design Specialist Ross Pearce to discuss some of the common hurdles businesses face when generating new products. One of the key failings Ross observes is becoming too precious about the thing you're working on. Passion is a great start, but is it enough to bring your idea to market successfully?

💡 We've put together a collection of free resources designed to empower Kiwi businesses on their path to success. Explore Product360 for the full suite of expert tips, advice and strategies to bring your innovation to life.

https://www.product360.nz/
